programme.title: Murder Without Conviction
programme.desc: One day after school, Morgan is talking to one of her friends, and the subject of horseback riding comes up. Morgan has never done it before and thinks it's easy, so she decides to take some lessons. Simply put, she's horrible. Morgan quits, but the jersey won't let her do that. It transforms her into a gymnist. Domnique Dawes reminds her of how she never gives up after only one try at something. Morgan returns as a new person, and finds a little success the second time around. Meanwhile, Coleman, Nick, and Elliot all need a new pair of shoes, but have absolutely no money. Nick's father, Larry, offers them a job at his office, ""Lighter than Air"". While there, Coleman finds some really cool clothes, Elliot finds office supplies, and Nick builds an enorous sandwich. Obviously, they didn't do their job. However, they meet Jim Harbaugh, star quarterback for the San Diego Chargers (at the time) and Larry lets the three each get a pair of new shoes for no apparent reason.

programme.title: The Pleasure of Your Company
programme.desc: THE NEXT GIRL I SEE is a comedy that shows us that love has nothing to do with perfection. After losing the woman of his dreams, Anderson is convinced he'll never fall in love again. But at the urging of his best friend, he spontaneously proposes to a dissatisfied waitress named Katie and an innocent dare evolves into the kind of love that both have been looking for all along.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Drama with Jaclyn Smith. A kindhearted judge agrees to take in a juvenile delinquent, hoping to help the youngster rehabilitate and face her troubled past.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: Earthsea
programme.desc: Based on the eponymous series of books by Ursula K. LeGuin, Earthsea centers on a young man whose destiny lies in his own hands; a man with the power to become the greatest sorcerer his world has ever known. The youthful protagonist, Ged, realises he possesses endless magical powers, and embarks on an adventure to master his mystical abilities. His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: A young Venetian, Marco is abandoned by his father for the merchant Silk Road in the hands of the Mongolian emperor, Kublai Khan, who is at war with China. Kublai recognizes Marco's observation skills, and teaches him the Mongolian culture.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Epic four-hour series about the rise of Octavius who succeeds Julius Caesar and tangles with Marc Anthony for control of the Roman empire and finally went on to become the emperor Augustus.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Marc Antony addresses the crowd at Caesar's funeral, where a shroud hides the deceased leader's stab wounds. Octavius' mother, Atia, recently imprisoned by Cassius, is allowed to speak at Caesar's funeral, but she tells the wild crowd that her son is Caesar's true heir. Meanwhile Camane, the psychic vestal virgin, has put her own life at risk by guarding the will, and Tyrannus, fearing for Octavius' life, once again takes the young heir away from the turbulence of Rome.

programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Word of Honor

programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Belgrado „Partizan" - Kauno „Žalgiris"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Furthermore, research suggests that it is widely considered to be the premier men's basketball league in the world. Legends of this particular sport include Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Barselonos „FC Barcelona“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Ancient Aliens Special Presentation
programme.desc: With our latest technological advancements, humanity has entered a new era in the search for life outside of our planet. From the discovery of exoplanets and the exploration of the moon to plans for missions to Mars, could man's quest to understand the universe be built into our DNA? Across the globe, many cultures believe that their ancestors came from the stars. Orion, Sirius and Pleiades are all connected to origins stories for ancient cultures around the world. As scientists continue to explore outer space, are we on the verge of discovering not only alien life but the very extraterrestrials that came to Earth centuries ago?

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: World's Biggest Bullshark

programme.title: Planet Carnivore: Perfect Killers
programme.desc: Great white sharks, polar bears, lions and brown bears battle rivals and the elements to maintain their positions at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: Dr Oakley: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: No two days are ever the same for Dr. Michelle Oakley, the only all-species vet for hundreds of miles in the Yukon. She could be chasing boars by helicopter, stalking wolverines in the wilderness, performing surgery on a jaguar, or facing any number of new challenges with the amazing animals of the north. Animals are incredibly important to the people of the Yukon, and Dr. Oakley will do anything to keep them safe and healthy.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: United States of Animals: Compilation
programme.desc: Animal feedings are happening annually in the United States, and many animals travel coast to coast to satisfy their appetites. From millions of moth-hungry bats in Texas to bald eagles fighting over fish in Maryland, this group of animals knows where to go to get what they want off the menu. These food-driven voyages come with great reward, and some of these feedings may be closer than you think. If you're hungry to find out more, this field guide will mark the spot of an animal feeding near you.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Sharks of Lost Island
programme.desc: A team of highly motivated scientists led by National Geographic Explorer-in-Residence Enric Sala sets out on a treacherous journey to the Pitcairn Islands, a remote archipelago in the Pacific Ocean, to document the environment both in the sea and on land with hopes of turning this potentially pristine ocean environment into a protected marine reserve. For thirty days and thirty nights, hundreds of miles from anywhere, Sala's expedition will tackle the mysteries of the Pitcairns head on, hitting all four islands in the chain. Not much is known about the islands and each tells a unique story. Following in the same vein as his previous odysseys (and films), Enric Sala leads the charge on yet another groundbreaking expedition to document what healthy reefs should look like and explore what could be one of the last pristine ocean locations on earth. This is exploration at its most extreme and isolated. And in this remote corner of the planet, the stakes are high.

programme.title: Pristine Seas
programme.desc: Follow National Geographic Explorer, Enric Sala, and his Pristine Seas project as they travel the globe to save our oceans.

programme.title: Super Reefs
programme.desc: In 2009, National Geographic Pristine Seas explored the southern Line Islands and found pristine coral reefs, thriving ecosystems teeming with sharks and huge schools of fish. But in 2015-16, an unprecedented ocean warming event killed half of the corals. The Pristine Seas team returned in 2021, hoping to see some signs of recovery. What they found instead was the most spectacular recovery of coral reefs ever witnessed.

programme.title: Nature's Glow
programme.desc: Dive into a world where science feels like magic. Nearly a third of deep-sea species glow. Uncover the brilliant science behind bioluminescence. From inky oceans to sparkling glowworm caves and firefly forests, meet creatures that defy our imaginations. By using nature's original language of light, many creatures use their glow to hunt, hide, communicate and even deceive. Along the way, leading scientists reshape technology, health and the story of life on Earth.

programme.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough draws on a lifetime of experience to reveal Earth's most spectacular underwater habitats, showing that we're in the greatest age of Ocean discovery and highlighting its vital importance. While exposing the Ocean's biggest challenges, Attenborough's message is one of hope: the opportunity for marine life recovery on an unprecedented scale is within reach.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: Alaska's Deadliest: Predator Prowl
programme.desc: North America doesn't get much colder, nor any darker than Alaska in winter. It's not a place you mess with, unless you've got a wild side. As winter breaks, carnivores emerge on Alaska's wide-open spaces, leaving prey animals no place to hide. Wolves chase caribou with ferocious intensity, brown bears battle for rights to a buffet and wolverines make short work of prey 100 times their size. Alaska's deadliest thrive in one of America's last wild frontiers.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Examine the weirdest animals that hide deep beneath the soil's surface. A worm explodes from the seabed to yank fish into its mucky pit; a beetle tunnels deep into warm, wet dung; and a miniature digger excavates miles of tunnel with its teeth! Some hunt in swarms to overwhelm living prey, while solo operators rely on disguise and trickery to trap victims. Tunnellers display bizarre and ingenious solutions to survive in cramped, stuffy and dark conditions.

programme.title: Planet Carnivore: Perfect Killers
programme.desc: Great white sharks, polar bears, lions and brown bears battle rivals and the elements to maintain their positions at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: World's Weirdest Animal Faces
programme.desc: Majestic animals we deem beautiful are well documented. Their stories are celebrated while we appropriate their regality, elegance and grace to adorn our company logos, be our sporting mascots and represent our families on crests. Then there's the other animals, the aesthetic outsiders we don't consider cute or cuddly. The critters we tend to laugh at or revile simply because they don't fit into what we deem as beautiful. The animals selected by natural selection to be beaten with the ugly stick. This is the time for the World's Weirdest Animal Faces to shine! A celebration of respectable irreverence, revealing the extraordinarily weird features these creatures possess.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale
programme.desc: The Nicobar Islands were significantly impacted by the massive tsunami of 2004. This documentary is a compelling exploration of nature's ability to adapt to millions of years of gradual tectonic change and a sudden natural disaster, and a journey into a world few people are fortunate enough to see.

programme.title: Return of the Predators
programme.desc: After 30 years of war and destruction, Gorongosa National Park in Mozambique has undergone a remarkable restoration. Herbivores once again bound across the plains, but hunters have been slower to return, leaving the park out of balance...until now!

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale

programme.title: Wild Hunters: Deadly Killers of Africa
programme.desc: Journey across Africa exploring the continent's most iconic and deadliest predators. These African stories are a show of raw power, strength and endurance. An awe-inspiring display of the fierce, everyday battles fought in the wild.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Exploring Vietnams Mekong Delta, home to macaques, turtles, and crocodiles.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx. But for the female lynxes of the valley, it is always a challenge to raise their cubs. The series follows the lynxes in their struggle for survival, from the thrill of the hunt to the tender moments of parenting, and also witnesses their coexistence with other animals like majestic golden eagles or powerful deer.

programme.title: Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale
programme.desc: The Nicobar Islands were significantly impacted by the massive tsunami of 2004. This documentary is a compelling exploration of nature's ability to adapt to millions of years of gradual tectonic change and a sudden natural disaster, and a journey into a world few people are fortunate enough to see.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: It's Kindness Day! Mr. Guzman announces that if all students complete one act of kindness, they'll get a class pizza party-and Hazel wants that pizza! But when Dev refuses to participate, Cosmo and Wanda call on the Pe-Az, a trio of alien diplomats, to reason with him. Despite their best efforts, Dev outsmarts the Pe-Az and uses their alien technology to get rid of all the pizza on Earth. // Hazel must take matters into her own hands to get to the bottom of Dev's surly attitude and save pizza! When Hazel makes a wish to understand why Dev acts the way he does, she gets paired with him for a class scavenger hunt. They struggle to work together, but, as the day goes on, they develop a friendship. However, that falls apart when Dev's dad, Dale, belittles their effort, causing Dev to turn on Hazel again to save face. Will Dev be able to overcome his pride and finish the project, or will his issues with his dad tank both their grades?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Having filled up another wish card, Hazel is enjoying a fun, fantasy wish. Meanwhile, Cookie, the fairy who got bested by Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda after their Wish Trials, is setting a trap for our trio. She tricks them into publicly talking about magic at a fake museum exhibit, records the evidence, and then takes them to Fairy Court. Now, Hazel must prove that Cosmo and Wanda are innocent, or else lose them forever. // Frustrated by her mom's split attention between work and home, Hazel wishes to be her assistant to spend more time with her. Cosmo and Wanda turn Hazel into an adult, and she spends the day struggling to fulfill her duties. Even though being a working adult is hard, Hazel is excited to be spending so much quality time with Angela. But when the puppet standing in for Hazel at school gets called into the nurse's office, Angela rushes off to take care of it and Hazel must give the presentation instead!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev's dad, tech magnate Dale Dimmadome, creates an app designed to track kids' wants at the annual Founder's Day Festival, but Hazel shows up as an anomaly thanks to Cosmo and Wanda's wish granting. Dale programs giant robots to track her down.

The next thing Timmy knows, Dad's in his class! // Unable to resist the taste of Jorgen's grandmother's delicious brownies,Timmy steals the top secret recipe which gets downloaded into his brain. Timmy now faces danger at every turn as he learns that the fate of the magical universe is determined in a bakeoff between the fairies, anti-fairies and pixies.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "HALF-HOUR SUMMER VACATION SPECIAL The penguin's worst nightmare has come true. After a sailing trip gone wrong they wind up in the Hoboken Zoo. Strangely, the animals are happy, the zoo is a paradise, and life couldn't be better! Zookeeper Frances takes outstanding care of all of them or does she? Something sinister bubbles under the surface the happy animals are actually androids, and the real animals are held captive in a dungeon. They're too messy and Zookeeper Frances can't stand a mess! A rescue comes from a very unlikely source, and the final battle could go either way!".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Pet's Peeved: The notorious Vesuvius Twins have adopted Skipper and King Julien and brought the animal's home to their luxury apartment. Not to spoil and pamper - but to fight each other over shiny baubles! The rest of the penguins and lemurs attempt a rescue but are captured themselves and made to perform in a painful "circus" the twins put together. The tables are going to need to be turned to get this circus out of town. Byte-Sized: Kowalski has another breakthrough invention, tiny robots that group together and not only fix broken tools and appliances, but run them as well. The penguins can just sit back and let the "Nanites" take care of all their chores! The problem is, the Nanites are programmed to protect the penguins at all costs, and ultimately seal the birds inside their lair. The only way to escape is to do battle with a giant, nasty, Nanite robot.".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: "SpongeBob adopts a stray worm, and to his surprise, the worm gives birth to some worm babies overnight! But since Gary won't play nice, SpongeBob needs to find loving homes for his new slimey, weird-looking friends. / Plankton is sick of Karen's criticisms, so he decides he can just replace her with some new computer inventions! But when he takes them out on a Krabby Patty formula-stealing mission, he learns that Karen truly is one of a kind".

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: An exhausted Timmy makes a wish for complete darkness so he can get some sleep. But he doesn't count on Cosmo and Wanda turning into Scary Fairies in the dark, and now, in a manic episode set in the pitch black of night, Timmy's on the run from all the crazy things that go bump in the night! // Dad shipwrecks the Turners on a desert island and has to save the family before the island is blown up by a secret government bomb.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, Katara and Sokka have run out of money. Katara suggests Sokka get a job, and coincidentally, they meet a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. But when the fisherman recognizes Aang as the Avatar, he blames Aang's absence for all of the troubles of the last 100 years, and Aang runs away on his glider. Katara follows on Appa, and when she finds him, Aang begins to reveal life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, Prince Zuko and Lieutenant Jee get into a fight, but Iroh breaks it up. Soon thereafter, the Lieutenant and the rest of the crew gain a newfound respect for their leader after learning of his past.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: No Hat for Pat: Patrick is sick of all of his friends not being able to play with him because they have to put on their Krusty Krab hats and go to work. So when Mr. Krabs offers him a job as a sign-holder, Patrick is thrilled because it means he gets to wear a hat and work with all his friends! But Pat soon learns that wearing a hat isn't as simple as it looks. Toy Store of Doom: A new toy store has opened up in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob and Patrick couldn't be happier! In fact, they are having so much fun at the toy store that they accidentally get locked in when it closes. They soon find out that things are a lot different at the toy store when no one's around...

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: A friendly day at the beach turns into all-out war in 'Sand Castles In The Sand', and then in 'Shell Shocked', an accident-prone SpongeBob damages Gary's shell, and must find a replacement. 11:01 Rock, Paper, Scissors Rock, Paper and Scissors are three best friends who share an apartment together and compete over everything. Week to week, they have tiny problems that always get out of hand. (Subtitled).

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. But Raph's dream may become a nightmare, as Raph is oblivious to the fact that he's walked right into their trap!

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: The Maltos enjoy a snow day while, back at Base, something has the Autobots in a red-hot rage... When Twitch returns to HQ for snacks, she gets trapped inside and finds herself stuck in the middle of the scariest family feud of all-time. Can Twitch survive long enough to cure her allies before they tear each other apart?

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: Afraid to be embarrassed at a dance-off, Draculaura secretly gives her dance partner, Clawd, enchanted shoes. // Cleo wants the lead role for the school play and raids her family's ancient tomb for a perfect, superior costume.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Chaos

programme.title: Regretting You - Tutto quello che non ti ho detto
programme.desc: Quando un incidente devastante rivela un tradimento sconvolgente, Morgan e sua figlia Clara esplorano ciò che resta loro alle spalle, affrontando segreti di famiglia, ridefinendo il loro legame e riscoprendo se stesse.

programme.title: Chief Of Station - Verita' a tutti i costi
programme.desc: Intrighi e menzogne in un thriller con Aaron Eckhart e Olga Kurylenko. La morte della moglie porta un ex agente CIA a collaborare con un avversario per svelare una cospirazione.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Paul Greengrass dirige il secondo action con Matt Damon nei panni dell'ex agente della CIA. Lasciato indietro il passato, Bourne torna in campo per un'ingiusta accusa di omicidio.

programme.title: Non così vicino
programme.desc: Marc Forster dirige Tom Hanks in una pellicola dolceamara. Dopo la morte della moglie, Otto è un uomo rigido e solo. Ma la sua vita sarà sconvolta dall’arrivo di una nuova vicina.

programme.title: Hunting Season
programme.desc: Un padre iperprotettivo e la figlia dodicenne accolgono una giovane trovata sulla riva di un fiume. Le vite di padre e figlia cambiano per sempre con l'arrivo della sconosciuta.

programme.title: Old Way, The
programme.desc: La tranquillita' di un ex pistolero viene sconvolta dall'omicidio della moglie. In preda alla sete di vendetta, inizia una furiosa caccia agli assassini che coinvolgera' anche sua figlia, decisa a seguire le orme del padre (US 2023).

programme.title: L'ammissione
programme.desc: Tina Fey e Paul Rudd in una divertente commedia. La vita di Portia, responsabile alle ammissioni di Princeton, viene sconvolta quando ritrova John, un ex compagno del college.

programme.title: Johnny Stecchino
programme.desc: Capolavoro di comicita' diretto e interpretato dal premio Oscar Roberto Benigni. Nel duplice ruolo di un boss latitante e del suo sosia, l'attore toscano si trova coinvolto in una girandola di spassosi equivoci quando si innamora della moglie di un pentito che la mafia ha condannato a morte. La donna, infatti, vuole far credere che l'ingenuo giovanotto sia il marito per farlo eliminare! Sfuggito casualmente ai numerosi agguati, tra esilaranti furti di banane passati alla storia del cinema, il nostro autista forse riuscira' a salvare la pelle...

Simon Keller, un famoso ladro americano, ha bisogno di un autista per mettersi in salvo dopo una rapina in banca. Alla fine la scelta cade su Peter Roberts, un ex pilota di Formula Uno, all'oscuro dei piani del criminale. Keller lo assume come istruttore e mette a segno il colpo proprio durante una delle lezioni di guida. Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.desc: Opera prima di Christoph Waltz, star di un biopic con Vanessa Redgrave e Annette Bening. Il giovane arrivista Ulrich Mott sposa l'anziana Elsa Breht, che un giorno viene trovata uccisa...

programme.desc: Biopic con Sergio Castellitto e Alessandro Sperduti, diretti da Pupi Avati. 30 anni dopo la morte di Dante Alighieri, il Boccaccio ne ripercorre la vita in un viaggio da Firenze e Ravenna.

programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.desc: Oscar a Eddie Redmayne, al fianco di Felicity Jones nel biopic sullo scienziato Stephen Hawking: una vita segnata dalla malattia, dalla scienza e dall'insuperabile amore per la moglie Jane.

programme.desc: Pellicola d'animazione dai creatori di "The Lego Movie". Le cicogne consegnano ormai i bebe' online, ma un imprevisto obbliga il loro miglior corriere a una corsa contro il tempo.

programme.title: Il mistero della casa del tempo
programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.title: Baby Boss 2 - Affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Sequel dell'animazione di successo targata Dreamworks. Tim e Ted sono diventati adulti e si sono allontanati l'uno dall'altro, finche' una missione top secret non li costringe a riunirsi.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

La nascita dell’amicizia fra Scooby-Doo e Shaggy si intreccia con un nuovo caso da risolvere per la Mystery Inc., alle prese con il malvagio Dick Dastardly, che vuole liberare il cane infernale Cerbero.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Fino in North Carolina, dove vive un costruttore di barche con un doloroso passato da dimenticare.

I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.
